caveats: Net value is a volume-weighted model estimate: allocation_m3 times province margin_cad_m3, divided by 1e6. It is not an observed transaction, a policy result, or a combined national net value.
The Forest LP objective and every Forest LP v1 output are unchanged. Net value is used only for reporting and is not an LP objective or constraint.
Negative margins and negative net values are retained without clipping. A negative value is a model result, not a data error.
Infeasible allocation cases keep blank allocation and blank net-value fields. They are not clamped, back-filled, or allocated a zero value.
The allocation levels are alternative screening ladders, not additive years or independent jurisdictions. National totals are reported per allocation case and must not be summed across levels.
Donor-price and donor-cost provinces remain model estimates. Stumpage_scaled is a method sensitivity, not the base scenario.

Nunavut has zero allocation volume in the 119m provenance, but a non-zero unit margin. Its net value is zero by multiplication where allocated volume is zero and is not an observed zero-profit finding.

caveats: Evidence coverage comes first. Price evidence and cost evidence are separate overlays: 65 five-component price cells and 13 province-level cost-basis cells.
Price direct/reported coverage is 33.6% of the 119 Mm3 allocation; the remaining 66.4% uses a donor price.
Ten jurisdictions use a provisional StatCan NAICS 11331 industry aggregate cost proxy, 45.5% of observed 2024 harvest. It is not direct coverage.

The StatCan NAICS 11331 total expense includes administration, depreciation, overhead and non-logging activity, plus any in-forest haul performed by logging establishments. It is not a logging-only or haul-only cost curve and no separate road, silviculture or haul add-on is applied.
Nunavut is the only donor-fallback cost jurisdiction; StatCan reports zero expenses and zero harvest, so no CAD/m3 ratio is fabricated.
National values are volume-weighted model diagnostics shown last, not a combined national net value.
donor_flat is the base scenario. stumpage_scaled is the method sensitivity: the sensitivity, not the base; not observed and not policy grade.
Stumpage, dues, royalty and standing-value rates are charges on standing timber, not delivered log prices.
No jurisdiction row is an observed transaction, policy-grade value, Forest LP input or public OSeCAN input.
non_claims: Not a Forest LP objective or constraint input.
Not a legal AAC or a policy frontier.
The StatCan aggregate is not a logging or haul cost curve.
